key_catalyst: SK Hynix earnings miss triggering semiconductor/AI-capex selloff
reasoning: The July 29 semiconductor/AI-capex selloff drove QQQ down -1.26% intraday, but the July 30 pre-market rebounded a strong +1.79%, indicating the market absorbed the SK Hynix miss and Meta's disappointment. Microsoft's 'narrative changing' beat (Azure +43%, Cloud topping $100B) reframed AI monetization positively, while post-FOMC swap pricing actually cut September hike odds from ~82% to ~39%, de-escalating the rate-hike catalyst. With pre-earnings uncertainty resolved and a decisive overnight recovery, none of the catalysts remain the primary driver of an active drawdown.
